Off-campus Rowan University students in Glassboro, New Jersey, experienced a violent flash flood on August 27, 2026, when 4 to 6 inches of rain overwhelmed the area and shattered glass patio doors.

The Bright Side:
No student injuries were reported despite the terrifying sudden inundation and structural failure of the ground-floor doors.
